note: Tools recommended as ADDITIONS beyond the extracted spreadsheet inventory. These close concrete gaps (param fuzzing, GraphQL introspection, service fingerprinting, favicon pivots, DNS permutation, passive ports, alt content discovery, fuzz-prep glue). Kept separate from data/tool_inventory.json (which is verbatim-extracted). Consumed by recontool.inventory.build_state_matrix to render docs/tools/<slug>.md and the state-matrix workbook.

tools.name: dirsearch
tools.purpose: Recursive web path/file brute-forcer with rich extension handling and 404 calibration.
tools.best_use: Content/directory discovery on live hosts; complements ffuf/feroxbuster.
tools.rationale: Cat-20 alternative engine; some targets behave differently across fuzzers, dirsearch's extension/recursion model finds paths the others miss.

tools.name: qsreplace
tools.purpose: Rewrite query-string values across a URL list (fuzz-prep glue).
tools.best_use: Normalize/seed URL variants for parameter probing; pairs with gf/arjun/x8.
tools.rationale: Core pipeline plumbing referenced in the gap analysis but never listed as a tool; needed to turn harvested URLs into tuned fuzz inputs.

tools.name: fingerprintx
tools.purpose: Service fingerprinting for NON-HTTP services (databases, RDP, SSH, etc.).
tools.best_use: Run after naabu/nmap to identify protocol/product on open non-web ports.
tools.rationale: httpx/whatweb only fingerprint web; non-HTTP services had no dedicated identifier.

tools.name: gospider
tools.purpose: Fast Go web crawler (links, forms, JS, robots/sitemap, archive sources).
tools.best_use: Alternative/parallel crawler to katana/pycrawl for endpoint + JS harvesting.
tools.rationale: Crawler redundancy improves coverage; gospider's source aggregation differs from katana.

tools.name: x8
tools.purpose: Hidden HTTP parameter discovery via response-difference analysis.
tools.best_use: Deep param mining where Arjun misses; high-signal for fuzz prep.
tools.rationale: Modern, fast parameter brute-forcer; strengthens Cat-25 beyond Arjun/ParamSpider.

tools.name: clairvoyance
tools.purpose: Recover GraphQL schema even when introspection is disabled (suggestion-based).
tools.best_use: Map GraphQL attack surface after graphw00f detects an engine.
tools.rationale: Cat-23 had graphw00f (detection) but no schema-recovery; clairvoyance completes the GraphQL flow.

tools.name: dnsgen
tools.purpose: Generate subdomain permutation/mutation candidates from known names.
tools.best_use: Feed puredns/shuffledns/dnsx resolution (candidates, not confirmed assets).
tools.rationale: Referenced in gap analysis but unlisted; candidates feed active resolution, not the asset store directly.

tools.name: gotator
tools.purpose: Permutation generator with depth/number controls for subdomain wordlists.
tools.best_use: Higher-control alternative to dnsgen; candidates feed resolvers.
tools.rationale: Permutation engine redundancy; pairs with alterx/dnsgen for brute-DNS prep.

tools.name: smap
tools.purpose: nmap-compatible output using Shodan InternetDB data — ports WITHOUT scanning.
tools.best_use: Passive port/service picture before (or instead of) active naabu/nmap.
tools.rationale: Lets the port-scan category produce results in passive-only mode (no target contact).

tools.name: favfreak
tools.purpose: Compute favicon mmh3 hashes and pivot to related hosts via Shodan/ZoomEye.
tools.best_use: Find sibling infrastructure (incl. origin behind CDN) sharing a favicon.
tools.rationale: Underrated correlation pivot called out in the gap analysis; feeds Cat-1/Cat-2 recursion.

tools.name: fav-up
tools.purpose: Resolve real origin IP from favicon hash via Shodan (CDN-bypass discovery).
tools.best_use: Recover origin IPs to re-enter port scanning / network intel.
tools.rationale: Complements favfreak for origin-IP discovery; origin IPs re-enter Cat-21/Cat-3.
